zh: 新手引导里的工具页面会停一下后自动慢速向下滚动，到底后回到开头，高亮框和重点按钮标注跟着移动；滚动鼠标滚轮可以改为手动查看。
新手引导第一步可以用鼠标滚轮翻看输入框里的完整问题，发送后滚轮滚动对话区。
en: Tool pages in the product tour now pause, then slowly scroll down and return to the top, with the highlight and key-button markers following along. Use the mouse wheel to scroll them yourself.
In the first tour step you can use the mouse wheel to read the whole question in the composer, and the conversation after it is sent.
